manuscripts.title: Theta Differences, Class Group Characters, and the Rogers–Ramanujan Functions at Degree 29
manuscripts.summary: Expresses a family of Rogers–Ramanujan series as differences of binary theta series and identifies the class group characters in their Hecke decompositions. Degree 29 is the only member of the family with exactly two conjugate pairs of characters.

manuscripts.title: String Amplitude Residues Along Kinematic Curves
manuscripts.summary: Studies residues of four-point open and closed string amplitudes along varying momentum-transfer curves, including recovery of transfer data and bounds on massive-level remainders. It also develops rational bounds for pi using interpolation and differentiated Gauss sums, with asymptotic remainder estimates.
